methodology.baseline: compact JSON envelope with payload inline
methodology.boundary_aware: per sample, emit whichever complete envelope has fewer tokens under that tokenizer
methodology.corpus: 264 deterministic ASCII payloads: 3 classes x 11 byte sizes x 8 variants; every payload is below 1 KiB
methodology.crossover: first measured payload size whose aggregate ref envelope costs fewer tokens than aggregate inline envelope; previous sampled size is quoted
methodology.forced_ref: compact JSON envelope with SHA-256 tz://blob ref and raw byte count
methodology.integrity: all generated classes, sizes, and variants retained; unavailable tokenizer libraries disclosed, never estimated
methodology.ratio_direction: candidate tokens / inline tokens; below 1 is better

losses.explanation: Forced refs lose below the tokenizer-specific crossover. Boundary-aware packing selects the lower measured token count, so those payloads remain inline; this is selection, not a claim that ref framing is free.
